summary: The compact warm-brown cabin, simple gray gable roof, restrained trim, and sparse openings form a coherent and recognizable miniature with no obvious visible modeling defects. Principal-entry placement remains unverified.

orientation.summary: The actual inventory has one principal door on +v (SSE, 147°), matching the +v face render and avoiding duplicated portals. SV1 is geolocated southeast of the cabin and looks NW, so it correctly faces +v rather than proving a different side; however, the cabin’s +v wall is substantially obscured by trees and the doorway cannot be confirmed. The low-resolution north-up aerial also does not resolve an entrance. Road proximity and the author plan are not evidence.

issues.problem: No supplied source clearly establishes that the principal entry belongs on the +v/SSE face, so orientation is unresolved and cannot be approved.
issues.fix: Provide an unobstructed geolocated view or clearer north-up aerial/path evidence showing the target cabin’s doorway; then retain +v or move the single principal door to the evidenced face.
